sharedContract.payment: For a complete legally authorized cast, verify public preconditions, then commit actual Action and final priced RP with class-specific chronological Dissonance/Refrain and concentration transitions before interruptions. sharedContract.privacy: Known illegality differs from hidden facts. Resolve hidden alignment, faction permission/protection and corruption only after legal payment; expose only the promised result. No missing record becomes false, Neutral or zero by convenience. No secret diagnostic list.
sharedContract.clocks: Ready uses its current paid setup, real Reaction release and next-regular-start expiry. Summon/benefit clocks remain source-relative. Do not treat spell pulses as actor turns, pause deadlines in suppression, create extra turns or bank commands. Incomplete durations prevent complete end-to-end clock certification.
sharedContract.state: Preserve body identity, HP/injuries, resources, original memories, equipment/custody, alignment axes and imposed overlays, standing/history/permissions, corruption source IDs and parent dependencies, typed knowledge, source rank, exact timestamps, reservations and terminal reasons. Idempotent event IDs prevent replay. Audit inverse operations never authorize an in-world rewind.
sharedContract.overlap: Resolve an actual source permission within its exact scope. A standing-only predicate can change after maximization; membership/invocation/allied-status predicates remain independent. A protected alignment axis stays protected under its actual accepted rule. No universal priority, faction or soul engine is authored.

selectedSpellLocalContract.standing: Select a completed real standing update to native maximum+3 for the identified faction; Honored begins at+2 and does not satisfy maximized by itself. Preserve standing-v1 representation, absent/null keys and original historical acts. No alignment rewrite.
selectedSpellLocalContract.admission: Select willing recipient and one identified actual faction. Credentials, membership, office, alliance and invocation permission remain independent. Hidden restrictions receive no free preflight disclosure.
selectedSpellLocalContract.benefits: Preserve the promise of significant benefits, but do not fabricate a discount, credit line, training grant, service availability or institutional approval from a category list. A concrete named benefit record is mandatory and missing.
selectedSpellLocalContract.aftermath: Completed standing change persists without a new concentration requirement or ongoing dispellable standing spell. Later genuine source-authorized events can change standing. Recast is newly paid and cannot reset consumed one-time grants or erase adverse history. Benefit lifecycle depends on the missing named benefit, not an invented perpetual reward.
